description: This file defines the class vt_DateTime, which provides date and time manipulation functionalities such as constructing date-time objects, retrieving specific time components, and navigating through dates (days, weeks, months, years). It is a utility class used within the vtiger CRM project to handle date/time data systematically.

classes.name: vt_DateTime
classes.description: A class encapsulating date and time data and operations, including construction from components or timestamp, date navigation, and formatting within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: vt_DateTime
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the date-time object based on provided array of components or timestamp.

methods.name: getTodayDatetimebyIndex
methods.description: Returns a new vt_DateTime object representing a specific hour of the day based on index.

methods.name: getThisweekDaysbyIndex
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object representing a specific day of the current week based on index.

methods.name: getThismonthDaysbyIndex
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object representing a specific day in the current month based on index.

methods.name: getThisyearMonthsbyIndex
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object representing a specific month in the current year based on index.

methods.name: getHourendtime
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object set to the end of the current hour.

methods.name: getDayendtime
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object set to the end of the current day.

methods.name: getMonthendtime
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object set to the end of the current month.

methods.name: get_Date
methods.description: Returns the day of the week as a string.

methods.name: getmonthName_inshort
methods.description: Returns the short name of the month.

methods.name: getMonth
methods.description: Returns the month name.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Returns the year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the current month.

methods.name: getmonthName
methods.description: Returns the full month name.

methods.name: getdayofWeek
methods.description: Returns the full day of the week name.

methods.name: getdayofWeek_inshort
methods.description: Returns the short name of the day of the week.

methods.name: setDateTime
methods.description: Sets the date-time object based on a timestamp.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the date-time components from the object.

methods.name: get_formatted_date
methods.description: Returns the date in user-friendly format.

methods.name: get_DB_formatted_date
methods.description: Returns the date in YYYY-MM-DD format suitable for database storage.

methods.name: get_formatted_time
methods.description: Returns the time in HH:MM format.

methods.name: get_changed_day
methods.description: Returns a new vt_DateTime object for the previous or next day.

methods.name: get_first_day_of_changed_week
methods.description: Returns a new vt_DateTime object for the start of previous or next week.

methods.name: get_first_day_of_changed_month
methods.description: Returns a new vt_DateTime object for the start of previous or next month.

methods.name: get_first_day_of_changed_year
methods.description: Returns a new vt_DateTime object for the previous or next year.

methods.name: get_date_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of date components.

methods.name: getThisMonthsDayByIndex
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object representing a day in the current month based on index. (Note: There's a typo in the method name in code; should be 'getThisMonthsDayByIndex')
